contractFlowProfitReview.calculation: netProfit = expectedProfit - gasCost - deliveryCost - cacheRiskPenalty - publicMempoolRiskPenalty - slippageRiskPenalty - routeCorrelationPenalty

direct_onchain_protocol.profit_basis: contract_preview_required; paper signal is not used as minProfit

execution_plan.description: borrow an Aave asset, swap through selected target/intermediate tokens, and end in the same borrowed asset for in-contract repayment
forbidden_assumptions: external users can modify involved pools during this transaction
profit depends on pool prices changing while this transaction is executing
execution_plan.route_invariant: first route symbol must equal final route symbol; repay step must output the borrowed asset

deprecatedFields.profitableOnPaper: always false; paper/window data is only a signal and cannot prove executable profit
